title: Dino Merge Evolution
description: Fuse matching dinosaurs on your tactical battlefield to evolve fierce T-Rexes and armored beasts, then unleash your prehistoric squad in explosive auto-battles.
controls: Drag identical dinosaurs together on the grid to merge stronger tiers, then tap Fight to start the battle.

zh-CN.title: 合成进化恐龙
zh-CN.description: 超爽 3D 恐龙合成进化对战：拖拽两只相同恐龙合体进化成霸王龙与远古巨兽，排兵布阵碾压对面军团！
zh-CN.controls: 在战场上拖动两只相同恐龙合成更高级恐龙，布阵完成后点击开战碾压敌军。
